arxiv-2011-11667.title: What is nonlocal in counterfactual quantum communication?
arxiv-2011-11667.creator: Yakir Aharonov, Daniel Rohrlich
arxiv-2011-11667.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Yakir Aharonov, Daniel Rohrlich. We revisit the “counterfactual quantum communication” of Salih et al. cfc , who claim that an observer “Bob” can send one bit of information to a second observer “Alice” without any physical particle traveling between them. We show that a locally conserved, massless current—specifically, a current of modular angular momentum, L z L_{z} mod 2 ​ ℏ 2\hbar —carries the one bit of information.

arxiv-2108-03735.title: Constructing deterministic ω \omega -automata from examples by an extension of the RPNI algorithm
arxiv-2108-03735.creator: León Bohn, Christof Löding
arxiv-2108-03735.description: Abstract The RPNI algorithm (Oncina, Garcia 1992) constructs deterministic finite automata from finite sets of negative and positive example words. We propose and analyze an extension of this algorithm to deterministic ω \omega -automata with different types of acceptance conditions.

arxiv-2204-05635.title: Dimerization of dehydrogenated polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons on graphene
arxiv-2204-05635.creator: Zeyuan Tang, Bjørk Hammer
arxiv-2204-05635.description: Abstract Dimerization of polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) is an important, yet poorly understood step in on-surface synthesis of graphene (nanoribbon), soot formation, growth of carbonaceous dust grain in the interstellar medium (ISM). The on-surface synthesis of graphene and the growth of carbonaceous dust grain in the ISM require the chemical dimerization in which chemical bonds are formed between PAH monomers.

arxiv-2310-09211.title: The effect of solar wind on the charged particles’ diffusion coefficients
arxiv-2310-09211.creator: J. F. Wang, G. Qin
arxiv-2310-09211.description: Abstract The transport of energetic charged particles through magnetized plasmas is ubiquitous in interplanetary space and astrophysics, and the important physical quantities are the along-field and cross-field spatial diffusion coefficients of energetic charged particles. In this paper, the influence of solar wind on particle transport is investigated.

arxiv-2407-16072.title: An updated review on crosscorrelation of m-sequences This is an invited chapter to Series on Coding Theory and Cryptology, World Scientific
arxiv-2407-16072.creator: Tor Helleseth, Chunlei Li
arxiv-2407-16072.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tor Helleseth, Chunlei Li. Maximum-length sequences (m-sequences for short) over finite fields are generated by linear feedback shift registers with primitive characteristic polynomials. These sequences have nice mathematical structures and good randomness properties that are favorable in practical applications. During the past five decades, the crosscorrelation between m-sequences of the same period has been intensively studied, and a particular research focus has been on investigating the crosscorrelation spectra with few possibles values.

arxiv-2409-02655.title: UNC-104 transport properties are robust and independent of changes in its cargo binding
arxiv-2409-02655.creator: Amir Shee, Vidur Sabharwal, Sandhya P. Koushika, Amitabha Nandi, Debasish Chaudhuri
arxiv-2409-02655.description: Abstract Cargo distribution within eukaryotic cells relies on the active transport mechanisms driven by molecular motors. Despite their critical role, the intricate relationship between motor transport properties and cargo binding — and its impact on motor distribution — remains inadequately understood.

arxiv-2505-13267.title: Radio continuum spectra of SFGs in the XMM-LSS Field below-threshold
arxiv-2505-13267.creator: E.F. Ocran, A.R. Taylor, J.M. Stil, M. Vaccari, S. Sekhar, C.H. Ishwara-Chandra, Jae-Woo Kim
arxiv-2505-13267.description: Abstract This study investigates the radio spectral properties of K S -selected star-forming galaxies (SFGs) in the XMM-LSS field using extensive multiwavelength data. By employing various diagnostics, SFGs are distinguished from quiescent galaxies and AGN across seven redshift bins ( 0.1 ≤ z ≤ 3.0 \rm{0.1\leq\,\textit{z}\,\leq\,3.0} ).

arxiv-2512-16699.description: Abstract Aims. pmc-13406983.creator: Hyeran Jung, Minsun Jung
pmc-13406983.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Simple SummaryTesticular cancer is one of the most common cancers in young men aged 15 to 35. Although it is treatable when caught early, understanding how its burden changes over time is vital for planning healthcare services. Using national health insurance records from South Korea, this study tracked the number of men treated for testicular cancer each year from 2020 to 2024, alongside ten other conditions of the urinary system and kidneys.
